purpose: training and validation corpus for attack identification in the masked view; per-cycle encounter identity is the open candidate for what separates a dimmed flash from a refused one after an encounter

camdropWitness.method: frames at camdrop tap +0.20..+0.75 s (10 fps, 640x288 downscale), region x300-600 y40-140 (upper-right office below the HUD text); monitor-map frames (>=2500 near-grey bright px) skipped; occupant = saturated mass: Chica hue ~49 sat 0.6 (~10 000 px), Bonnie hue 239 sat 0.3 (~7 600 px), Freddy-in-office hue 20 sat 0.66 (8 400 px), Freddy-in-hall hue 21 sat 0.32 (~7 840 px, the doorway beam lighting him); empty office = grey 7 700 px (full beam) or 2 730 px (faint beam), sat <= 0.17
camdropWitness.indexRule: the camdrop sampled at "flash X" is the one 3.6 s AFTER that flash and belongs to mask window X+10 s; re-indexed, it agrees with the eyehole witness cycle for cycle
